title: Arthroscopic Wafer and Ulnar Shortening in Ulnar Abutment
brief_summary: there are many management options of ulnocarpal abutment depends on clinical evaluation and imaging of this joint. Arthroscopic treatment is the simplest solution for these conditions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* obvious ulnar abutment syndrome with ulnar side wrist pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* ulnar minus or neutral variance
* central and radial wrist pain
* osteoarthritis of the wrist.
